subject: S11 re-review: CHANGES REQUIRED (R1 compound number words only; D1-D8 verified fixed)
body:
S11 REVIEW: CHANGES REQUIRED

Re-review of the S11 rework 6d06147 (done 20261117T020903-seg11-today-f37a4a). Tree: claude/naadi-shared at 38eab56, which contains 6d06147. No code edited. Provider keys blank; LLM mocked.

All eight original defects (D1–D8) are fixed and verified with my own probes. One narrow gap remains in the D2 fix: compound number words. It is the same rule D2 was about, so I am holding approval for it. The fix is small (see R1).

## What I ran (fresh stack recreated: pg-rev11 :54492, st-rev11 :54592, auth-rev11 :54493; E2E_PORT=7992)
- db suite on the fresh stack: 377 passed, 1 skipped (the perf test needs a reindexed corpus). Unit pytest: 840 passed. Lint (biome/ruff/format): clean. Typecheck (tsc/mypy): clean. Vitest: web 271, shared 125, ink 70, ui 27 passed. gen:contracts + gen:requirements: no drift. Seed OK.
- e2e smoke, today.spec + shell.spec, webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440, --retries=0 --workers=2: 87/87 passed twice (3.9 m, 3.5 m).
- CI run 43995510789 (sha 6d06147):
  - lint/typecheck/unit/drift/models/build GREEN; db integration GREEN; e2e firefox GREEN.
  - e2e chromium 772 passed / 2 failed; webkit 804 passed / 1 failed. today.spec and shell.spec pass in every project.
  - The reds are NOT S11: chromium-ipad-portrait and chromium-phone-412 fail S12b ink-sync.spec:310 (LWW delete/edit). webkit-ipad-landscape fails S09 exam.spec:341: a timeout waiting for the exam_scratch ink /changes save. Neither touches the Chip or the Logo.

## Fix verification (my probes)
- D1 FIXED.
  - PUT /api/onboarding at today+180 → 200 (180-day plan). At +181 → 422 `too_many_days` (details days=181, allowed=180).
  - Preview at +180 → ok. At +181 → ok:false, problem too_many_days, max_days 180.
  - Exam in 2099 → 422 in 0.02 s; preview for 2999 → too_many_days in 0.02 s (was 12 s / 7.3 s). After the refusals the earlier 180-day plan is untouched.
  - The date picker's max is today+180 (e2e asserts it).
- D2 FIXED for every reported case: "twelve…triple", "a hundred…double", "Q99"/"a20", "XL", ９９, ٩٩, "1/2" and "3rd" are all dropped. Valid text with digits or words ("five of twelve", "seven days") is kept. New gap in R1.
- D3 FIXED. 6 concurrent POST /api/diagnostic → one 201 and five 200, all the same block_id. One open diagnostic in the db (partial unique index, 0014).
- D4 FIXED. Repeated coach_pass with a fake gateway that writes llm_usage (user_id, run_id), as the real gateway does:
  - run 1: 1 call; runs 2 and 3: 0 calls (`already_coached`), so 1 call in total and the llm row stands.
  - rate_limited on the first student → budget_spent False (note `budget_rate_limited`).
  - daily_cap → budget_spent True, 1 call in the whole pass.
  - The real gateway records ctx.user_id and ctx.run_id ("coach:<date>") in llm_usage (llm.py:467, llm_budget reserve).
- D5 FIXED. `order by s.last_coached_at nulls first, p.user_id`; last_coached_at is set for every student looked at. Covered by test_the_least_recently_coached_student_goes_first, and I read the code.
- D6 FIXED. Copy is now "What you already use" and "Next: a 40-question diagnostic that shows where you stand in each system." (seen in the welcome-filled screenshot).
- D7 FIXED. The "Now" chip uses the new `current` tone (neutral outline), seen in the today-first-day screenshot. limeCount now scans every visible element except [data-brand-mark] and asserts 1 on Today.
- D8 FIXED:
  - (a) daily_hours 1 → max target_hours 1.0.
  - (b) readiness_caption takes {days}.
  - (c) as `authenticated`: new→accepted refused (InsufficientPrivilege); new→dismissed allowed; dismissed→new refused (CheckViolation), also for the service role.
  - (d) profile, plan and completed_at are written in one as_service transaction; save_profile merges settings.onboarding, so school and materials are kept.
  - (e) an invalid time zone → 422; "America/Los_Angeles" is saved to the profile and used for the start day.
- Shared changes: Chip gains tone `current` (additive; `now` unchanged, still used by the System page). LogoMark gains `data-brand-mark` (attribute only). No regressions: shell.spec 100 % locally and in CI, and the only CI reds are the unrelated ink/exam specs above.

## Defects

1. **R1 — Medium — a compound number word gets past the coach check when its parts are in the facts (the remaining gap in D2).**
   Repro: numbers_ok("Try twenty-five questions.", {system:"Cardiovascular", percent:42, attempts:12, correct:5, questions:20}) → True. "twenty" and "five" are checked separately (20 and 5), and both are in the facts. catch_up_block facts always carry questions = 20, so any invented "twenty-<n>" passes whenever n is also a fact. Same class: "-5 points" passes (the sign is dropped), and fullwidth letters ("Ｔｗｅｌｖｅ") bypass `[A-Za-z]`.
   Expected: 25 is not in the facts, so the suggestion is dropped.
   Fix (suggest.py numbers_in_text):
   - NFKC-normalise the text first.
   - Combine runs of number words joined by a hyphen, a space or "and" ("twenty-five", "one hundred and five") into one value before comparing.
   - Keep a leading minus or "minus" as part of the number.
   - Add unit cases: "twenty-five", "one hundred and five", "-5", "Ｔｗｅｌｖｅ".
   Optional while there: "a couple"/"pair" (2) and "once" (1) are not counted. "score" counts as 20, which can drop an innocent "your score" suggestion; consider removing "score" from NUMBER_WORDS.

2. **R2 — Low (no change required for approval) — two passes running at once can still both call the model for the same student.** `_ATTEMPTED` is checked before the call with no lock. A second cron fire overlapping the first would double up. Optional: take pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('coach:'||user_id||date)) around check+call, or a single-flight guard on the pass.

R1 is the only blocker. Once it lands with the unit cases above, I expect to approve without another full run (unit + coach db tests).
